question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is "removed."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "Removed" means to take somebody/something off or away. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को हटा या मिटा देना) • Example: *It got so hot that he **removed**__ his tie and jacket.* • The sentence conveys that the mould was taken out and sliced into pieces once the clay had dried. • The correct answer is option 3. • Correct passage: The Chinese rulers were called the Shang. Chinese civilisation is one of the oldest civilisations of the world which __flourished__ in north-east China. The Chinese had thought __up__ a very clever way of casting weapons and pots which were made of bronze. These people first made a rough model of the object they wanted to cast or make. Then, they shaped the clay mould closely __around__ the prepared model. When the clay was dry, the mould was __**removed**__ and cut into pieces. These carved pieces were filled with molten bronze and left to cool down. In the final process, the mould was removed and a perfectly formed object was ______ (5) ______. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Slipped: **to slide accidentally and fall or nearly fall. (अचानक फिसल कर गिर पड़ना या गिरते-गिरते बचना) • **Closed: **to shut. (बंद करना या होना) • **Distanced: **to become less involved or connected with somebody/something. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से) अधिक मेल-जोल न रखना) 41:Tc9b, The correct answer is "revealed."
